body:
Resolved as **2 + 3** — the recommendation in the issue. Three PRs, one per repo that held a piece of the disjointness:

| Repo | PR | What it did | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| framework | #3840 | retired `client.ai.{nlq,suggest,insights}`, `DEFAULT_AI_ROUTES`, `AiProtocol`, and the six dead `Ai{Nlq,Suggest,Insights}*` spec schemas; gave the SDK the 10 methods the real routes answer | merged (`8b9d71e`) |
| cloud | objectstack-ai/cloud#902 | the ledger's SDK half became a reachability check — drives every `ai.*` method against the table `buildAIRoutes()` returns; `gap` 10 → 1, `UNMOUNTED_AI_CLIENT_METHODS` 3 → 0 | merged (`b98d601`) |
| objectui | objectstack-ai/objectui#2921 | the console panel stops offering `/nlq` `/suggest` `/insights` with "try it" bodies; its AI group now mirrors all twelve mounted routes | **open (draft)** |

The two sets are no longer disjoint: `client.ai` went from 3 methods that nothing answered to 10 that mounted routes do, and the AI surface went from 0/12 expressed to 10/12.

The two routes still unexpressed are recorded rather than forgotten. `GET /status` and `GET /effective-model` are `server-only` (operator diagnostics — and they now appear in the console panel, which is the audience they were written for). `POST /chat/stream` is the single remaining `gap`: the generic-SSE twin of `/chat` without the tool loop or persistence, left unexpressed deliberately because `ai.chatStream` already covers streaming against the fuller route. Express it if a caller ever needs raw model parts without the tool loop.

On the guard: `/api/v1/ai/` is now a bounded prefix exemption in the capstone (#3642) — bounded from both ends, only `ai.*` may use it and the reachability check lives in the repo that mounts the routes, next to them. The wildcard-only ratchet stays **0**; these URLs are matched before `matches()` is consulted, so they never touch the `* /ai/**` row that certified three dead methods for years. Mutation-checked: repointing `ai.models` at `/modelz` fails two tests in cloud, naming the method and the URL it built.

Closing on the strength of the two merged PRs and the decision being fully executed. objectstack-ai/objectui#2921 is the last mechanical step and is open with CI running — if it does not land, reopen this rather than filing fresh, since the panel is the one place a user can still click a 404.
